releases.notes:
### Added
- Two-factor authentication (TOTP): `/2fa enable|confirm|disable|status`, 8 backup codes, replay
  protection. Wrong codes count like wrong passwords. Secrets are stored encrypted. An administrator
  password reset switches it off. Paper and Fabric.
- `/sessions` shows how many saved sessions you have; `/sessions revoke` ends them and keeps you online.
- Notice when you log in from a different address than last time (audit event `LOGIN_NEW_ADDRESS`).
- `auth.online-mode.trust-proxy-uuid` (default `false`): an offline-mode backend behind an
  online-mode proxy skips the password for forwarded Mojang UUIDs.
- `/authadmin doctor` warns about PostgreSQL `ssl-mode: prefer` on remote hosts and about several
  players sharing one local address (a proxy without IP forwarding).
- Common passwords (bundled list) and a password equal to the player name are rejected.

### Security
- Paper: portals, inventory drag, armor stands, entity interaction and item use after a cancelled
  block use are now blocked before login.
- Fabric: if AuthSecured fails to initialize, joining players are kicked instead of staying frozen.
- The account rate limit is keyed by the stored account, so `sTeve` can no longer lock `Steve`.
- Only one password check per player at a time, so parallel `/login` commands cannot bypass the lockout.
- Paper: an authenticated player is only replaced by a connection from the same address.
- SQLite uses WAL and a 5 second busy timeout instead of failing with "database is locked".
- GitHub Actions are pinned by commit SHA; Gradle wrapper checksum; CodeQL workflow.

### Changed
- The default minimum password length is now 8 (was 10). Still configurable, minimum allowed is 8.
  Applies after a restart. Existing passwords are not affected.
- Database schema 5 (SQLite) / V5 (PostgreSQL): adds `last_login_ip_hash` and the two-factor columns.
  Back up the database first; an older jar will not start on it.
- `/2fa` is always allowed before login, even if missing from `restrictions.allowed-commands`.

### Fixed
- Shutdown waits up to 5 seconds for running password checks before the database closes.

# AuthSecured 1.2.7

Security follow-ups from the 1.2.6 review, plus Folia support and a new session option from
@nicki41.

## What's new

- Paper now runs on Folia.
- New option `session.extend-while-online` (default `false`): the session timeout counts from
  when a player leaves instead of from login. Useful on proxy networks sharing one database.

## Security and fixes

- Simultaneous registrations can no longer exceed `max-accounts-per-ip`; the limit is enforced
  atomically, also across servers sharing a PostgreSQL database.
- `/authadmin doctor` no longer treats hosts like `127.db.example.com` as loopback.
- Audit and login records queued at shutdown are no longer lost.

## Notes

- No configuration changes are required.
- Folia support has been covered only by the unit-test suite, not tested on a live Folia server.
- Paper and Fabric remain separate downloads; each Fabric file targets one exact Minecraft
  version and requires Fabric API.

# AuthSecured 1.2.6

Includes the 1.2.5 Fabric compatibility fix plus seven community contributions from @nicki41.

## What's new

- `/authadmin doctor` now also reports IP-unbound sessions on an offline-mode server, Argon2
  settings below the OWASP minimum, and unencrypted PostgreSQL connections to a remote host.
- Paper: players who have not logged in only see (and can tab-complete) the commands in
  `restrictions.allowed-commands`, so a player joining under an operator's name can no longer
  browse that operator's commands before logging in.
- The Argon2 and database worker threads have descriptive names, which makes thread dumps and
  profiler output (spark) readable.

## Contributors

A big thank you to [@nicki41](https://github.com/nicki41) for seven pull requests in this
release: the new doctor checks (#8), hiding commands before login on Paper (#9), the worker
thread names (#10), re-hashing on login (#7), command alias protection (#4), ending
authentication on admin reset/unregister (#3) and the GitHub Actions build (#5).

- `/authadmin resetpassword` and `/authadmin unregister` now also log out the account owner if
  they are online (Paper and Fabric), so a compromised account loses access immediately.
- Paper: password commands whose aliases are taken by another plugin (for example `/l`) are
  still redacted from the console log and intercepted before login.
- Passwords hashed with older, weaker Argon2 settings are automatically re-hashed with your
  current settings the next time the player logs in.

## Fabric compatibility

- The bundled SQLite driver is 3.49.1.0 (since 1.2.5). It cannot be relocated and takes
  precedence over other mods' copies; the older 3.53.x made Ledger crash on startup with an
  `ALTER TABLE players MODIFY COLUMN` error.

## Notes

- No configuration changes are required.
- Paper and Fabric remain separate downloads; each Fabric file targets one exact Minecraft
  version and requires Fabric API.

releases.notes:
# AuthSecured 1.2.3 Security Update

Recommended for every server. This release closes pre-login bypasses found in a security audit.

## Added

- Fabric support for Minecraft 26.3, using Fabric API 0.164.0+26.3.

## Security fixes

- `/changepassword` can no longer be used to guess passwords before logging in. It now goes
  through the same rate limits, failed-attempt counter, account lock and temporary-password
  expiry checks as `/login`. Before login it only works to finish a temporary-password reset.
- Fabric: players who have not logged in can no longer run commands through the signed-command
  packet (`/msg`, `/me`, or any command sent by a modified client). Every command is checked a
  second time right before it runs.
- A locked account now gives the same answer for right and wrong passwords, so the lock cannot
  be used to confirm a guessed password.
- The built-in (non-Redis) rate limiter can no longer be flooded into locking every player out.
- Paper: if the plugin fails to start for any reason, new logins stay blocked instead of the
  server running without authentication.

## Changes

- Players who have not logged in or registered cannot move at all: no walking, jumping,
  riding, gliding, ender pearls, portals or spectator teleports. Looking around still works.
  Controlled by `restrictions.freeze-player` (enabled by default).

## Fixes

- PostgreSQL: security audit events are stored correctly again. They were rejected before, which
  also disabled the `max-accounts-per-ip` registration limit.
- Spigot: all pre-login restrictions now load, and `/authadmin resetpassword` no longer needs
  Paper-only APIs.

## Notes

- No configuration changes are required. Paper and Fabric remain separate downloads; each
  Fabric file targets one exact Minecraft version and requires Fabric API.

## Downloads

- **Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Leaf (1.21 – 26.3):** `authsecured-paper-1.2.3.jar`
- **Fabric:** `authsecured-fabric-1.2.3+mc<version>.jar` — pick the file that matches your Minecraft version exactly and install the matching Fabric API.

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/touchfalls/AuthSecured/blob/v1.2.3/CHANGELOG.md)

releases.notes:
### Added
- Always-on redaction of password arguments from Fabric command diagnostics,
  profiler labels, and debug exception logs.
- Validation bounds for security, database, Redis, rate-limit, and session
  numeric settings, plus PostgreSQL `ssl-mode` support.

### Fixed
- Fabric now stays fail-closed when core initialization fails, blocks flight
  according to `restrictions.allow-flight`, and ignores stale asynchronous join
  callbacks after a disconnect or rapid reconnect.
- Invalid YAML reloads retain the last valid configuration snapshot.

### Changed
- Configuration lookups now use an immutable flattened snapshot, reducing work
  in high-frequency movement and packet restriction checks.
- `config.yml` now documents every active option, accepted values, units,
  reload behavior, environment variables, and security-sensitive defaults.
